objective: Fix missing candidate cache handling in negative-rich oracle runners.
root_cause: run_pilot.sh and run_topup.sh used cached candidate strategies without building/passing a matching candidate cache directory for the newly sampled subckts.
code_changes: Updated autoresearch/oracle-negative-rich-260629/run_pilot.sh to build missing caches and pass --candidate-cache-dir
Updated autoresearch/oracle-negative-rich-260629/run_topup.sh to build missing caches and pass --candidate-cache-dir
